emulators.name: mGBA
emulators.description: One emulator covers Game Boy, Game Boy Color, and Game Boy Advance. Portable build, no installer required.

emulators.name: melonDS
emulators.description: Nintendo DS emulator focused on accuracy and speed. Requires BIOS dumps from your own console before DS games can run.
emulators.note: melonDS cannot run DS games out of the box: it needs BIOS dumps (bios7.bin and bios9.bin, plus firmware.bin for the console's firmware menu) from a Nintendo DS, DSi, or 3DS that you own. PokeLauncher never downloads these copyrighted files — you must dump them yourself and select them in melonDS's own settings. Until then, DS games will not boot.
